scoring_justification: The rotational barrier is recomputed from the raw energy vs angle data (T1 recompute). Equilibrium distance compared to paper-reported 2.91 Å with tolerance. Self-reported barrier is cross-checked against recomputed barrier for consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference equilibrium distance (2.91 Å) and rotational barrier threshold (100 meV)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports optimal adsorption distance 2.91 Å from DFT and states the rotational barrier is very small/negligible; the 0.1 eV threshold is derived from the paper's claim of free rotation and weak physisorption.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and task specification
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported DFT results and the agreed verification threshold in the approved plan.

outputs.description: Optimized equilibrium distance (H₂ center-of-mass to coronene plane) from DFT geometry optimization.
Raw potential energy scan over rotation angle. The verifier recomputes the rotational barrier from this data.
Agent-computed rotational barrier. Verified for consistency with the barrier recomputed from energy_vs_angle.csv.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the DFT calculation of the H₂ rotational barrier on a graphite model (coronene). The barrier must be very small (≤0.1 eV) to support the paper's conclusion of weak physisorption. The verifier recomputes the barrier from the CSV and checks the reported distance.
